metadata.title: 7-Eleven Staff Training Master Dataset
notes: Hot-food listing is current as of checked date but store inventory varies.
Practical phrases/romaji are training aids; store-specific procedures follow the store/manual.
metadata.number_strategy: Store each base number once; append 円 dynamically. Store explicit つ/個/core 番 forms where useful.

quiz_patterns.name: Customer phrase -> action
quiz_patterns.display_template: Listen and choose what to do.
quiz_patterns.example: 袋いりません。 -> Do not add a bag.

quiz_patterns.name: Situation -> staff response
quiz_patterns.example: 温めてください。 -> はい。

quiz_patterns.display_template: Which hot-food item did the customer say?

quiz_patterns.name: Hot-food + quantity
quiz_patterns.display_template: Choose the correct item and quantity.
quiz_patterns.example: ななチキ、ふたつください。 -> ななチキ x2

quiz_patterns.name: Cigarette shelf number
quiz_patterns.display_template: Which shelf number did the customer request?
quiz_patterns.example: さんじゅうなな + 番 -> shelf #37

quiz_patterns.name: Mixed real checkout
quiz_patterns.display_template: Choose item, quantity, and extra request.
quiz_patterns.example: ななチキ、ふたつと、袋お願いします。 -> Nana-chiki x2 + bag

quiz_patterns.tts_template: 温めて、箸もお願いします。
